title: 第25章 小妹第26章 解锁两件新图纸
slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地
content_zh:
;;
沈坤眼神冷漠，俯视着双膝跪地仰头失去动静的冯有田。
随即右手拧着一股蛮力。
生生将短刺从其头颅中拔出！
失去了支撑。
冯有田的尸体“咚”的一声颓然倒地，破开的脑颅在地面上溢出一滩血水。
不远处，看到这行动如狂风骤雨般的屠杀一幕，以及弥漫出来的血腥气味。
刘二狗的大脑瞬间被冲击呆滞，眼神直勾勾的盯着，整个人傻在了原地。
裤裆下传来一片温热湿润。
他吓尿了。
没想到，沈坤这小兔崽子出手这么狠啊！？
更没想到，在自己眼里人高马大、孔武有力的老大冯有田，居然被年纪轻轻的沈家老二这么容易就给杀掉了！
连一丝招架的余地都没有！
眼看着自己平日里最为畏重的冯有田脑袋破开个大洞躺在地上，一声不吭的。
刘二狗咽了咽干涩发紧的喉咙，心中涌出莫大庆幸，还好倒在这个地上的不是自己。
冯有田死了，他能活下去！
刘二狗脸上露出一抹轻松的笑容，转头想要看向沈家老大。
噗嗤！
然而，在他头颅方才扭转了一丝弧度的时候。
一根短刺毫无征兆地从上方斜下而来，“啪”的一声，没入了他整个头颅，轻易将其横向贯穿！

刘二狗脸上犹自带着笑容，眼神在最后流露出一抹茫然和不解。
不是说好了，帮他们把冯有田叫过来，就会放过自己吗？
不过他已经没有机会去质问沈家兄弟。
甚至连说话的机会都没有。
生机眨眼断绝，尸体无力栽倒在了一旁。
沈易随意抽出了阴木短刺，在刘二狗的衣物上擦拭干净。
“大哥，他们两个的尸体怎么处理？”沈坤起身走来，低声问道。
沈易看向外面的天色，已经是黑了下来，并且有精怪活动的动静逐渐响起。
看来今晚是回不去了。
本来只是想着先来处理掉刘二狗，再挑个日子解决冯有田。
但好巧不巧碰到冯有田手下的人过来给刘二狗送肉，他便想着索性将冯有田一并给解决了。
难免耽误了不少回去的时间。
不过，能够解决掉这两个对他们家有歹心的恶狗，积压在兄妹三人心头的隐患终于散去。
这一趟总算没白来。
今日在见到冯有田和刘二狗离去时那个狠毒的眼神，沈易知道，他们绝不会就此罢休。
更别说刚才在门外听到刘二狗的言语，更是让沈易杀心大盛。
对付这类恶棍，必须除恶务尽，以绝后患！
他已经死过一次，绝对不会在这个混乱的黑暗世道，再任由他人肆意欺压拿捏！
沈易目光转向老二，缓缓道：
“把他们扔出去，让精怪尝尝味道。”

“是！”

Shen Kun's eyes were cold, looking down at Feng Youtian who was kneeling on his knees, looking up and motionless.
Then his right hand twisted with brute force.
Pull the short thorn out of his head every time!
Lost support.
Feng Youtian's body slumped to the ground with a "thud" sound, and a pool of blood spilled from his broken head on the ground.
Not far away, I saw this scene of massacre like a violent storm, as well as the smell of blood.
Liu Ergou's brain was instantly stunned by the impact, his eyes were staring straight at him, and he was dumbfounded on the spot.
There was a warm and wet sensation under his crotch.
He was so scared that he peed.
I didn’t expect that little bastard Shen Kun would be so cruel! ?
What's more, he didn't expect that Feng Youtian, the eldest son who he thought was tall and powerful, would be killed so easily by the young second son of the Shen family!
There's not even a hint of room to parry!
Seeing Feng Youtian, who was usually the most fearful of him, lying on the ground with a big hole in his head, silently.
Liu Ergou swallowed his dry and tight throat, and felt extremely happy in his heart. Fortunately, he was not the one who fell on the ground.
Feng Youtian is dead, but he can live on!
A relaxed smile appeared on Liu Ergou's face, and he turned to look at the boss of the Shen family.
Poof!
However, just when his head turned a little bit.
A short thorn came diagonally from above without any warning, and with a "pop" sound, it penetrated into his entire head, easily penetrating it horizontally!
Liu Ergou still had a smile on his face, but his eyes showed a hint of confusion and confusion at the end.
Didn't you agree that if you help them call Feng Youtian over, you will let yourself go?
But he no longer had the chance to question the Shen brothers.
There wasn't even a chance to speak.
Life was cut off in the blink of an eye, and the body fell to the side helplessly.
Shen Yi casually pulled out the Yinmu short thorn and wiped it clean on Liu Ergou's clothes.
"Brother, what should we do with their bodies?" Shen Kun stood up and walked over, asking in a low voice.
Shen Yi looked at the sky outside. It was already dark, and there were sounds of ghostly activity gradually coming out.
It seems I can't go back tonight.
Originally, I just wanted to deal with Liu Ergou first, and then pick a day to deal with Feng Youtian.
But by chance, he happened to meet Feng Youtian's men coming to deliver meat to Liu Ergou, so he thought of simply dealing with Feng Youtian as well.
It inevitably delayed a lot of time to go back.
However, after being able to deal with these two evil dogs who had evil intentions towards their family, the hidden dangers that had accumulated in the hearts of the three siblings were finally dissipated.
This trip was finally not in vain.
When he saw the vicious looks in Feng Youtian and Liu Ergou's eyes today when they left, Shen Yi knew that they would never give up.
Not to mention the words Liu Ergou heard outside the door just now made Shen Yi murderous.
To deal with such villains, we must eliminate all evil to avoid future troubles!
He has already died once, and he will never let others bully and manipulate him in this chaotic and dark world again!
Shen Yi turned his eyes to the second child and said slowly:
"Throw them out and let the spirits have a taste."
"Yes!"
